changeSet.author: KJ
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE feedback ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, course_id BIGINT NOT NULL, name TEXT, intro TEXT, introformat BIGINT, lang TEXT, anonymous BIGINT, email_notification BOOLEAN, multiple_submit BOOLEAN, autonumbering BOOLEAN, site_after_submit TEXT, page_after_submit TEXT, page_after_submit_format BIGINT, publish_stats BOOLEAN, time_open TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, time_close TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, time_modified TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, completion_submit BOOLEAN, course_module BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_feedback_course FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES course (id) );

changeSet.author: KJ
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE feedback_item ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, feedback_id BIGINT NOT NULL, template TEXT, name TEXT, label TEXT, presentation TEXT, typ TEXT, has_value BIGINT, position BIGINT, required BOOLEAN, depend_item BIGINT, depend_value TEXT, options TEXT, item_number BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_fitem_feedback FOREIGN KEY (feedback_id) REFERENCES feedback (id) );

changeSet.author: KJ
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE feedback_attempt ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, feedback_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, time_modified TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_fattempt_feedback FOREIGN KEY (feedback_id) REFERENCES feedback (id), CONSTRAINT fk_fattempt_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user" (id) );

changeSet.author: KJ
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE feedback_response ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, attempt_id BIGINT NOT NULL, name TEXT, printval TEXT, rawval TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_fresponse_attempt FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id) REFERENCES feedback_attempt (id) );
